reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
The app is straightforward but despite its simplicity, it glitches frequently.  It appears there is an option to attach photos. When a photo is selected the app instantly closes. 🤔
My hope is that problem is corrected soon.  I appreciate how intuitive the app is to operate; it just needs to stay open long enough to receive entries. 🤞🏻⚓️
